gloss: beginning of the year; start of the year

definitions.gloss: beginning of the year; start of the year
definitions.explanation: The start of a new calendar year, typically January. Often used in formal contexts such as New Year addresses, goal-setting, and business greetings.

examples.japanese: {年頭|ねんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べる→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: To give a New Year's greeting.

examples.japanese: {年頭|ねんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}てた→立てる：01196_tateru⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えています→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you still remember the goals you set at the beginning of the year?

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{年頭|ねんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{所感|しょかん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経営|けいえい}→経営：02740_keiei⟧⟦{方針|ほうしん}→方針：04871_houshin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{全社員|ぜんしゃいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}した→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: The company president announced the management policy for this year to all employees as a New Year's address.

notes:
Refers to the beginning of a new year, typically January. Combines ⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ (year) and ⟦{頭|とう}→頭：18067_tou⟧ (head, beginning).

USAGE:
- Used in formal and semi-formal contexts, especially for greetings, speeches, and goal-setting
- Common in business settings where executives give {年頭|ねんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧ (New Year's address) or {年頭|ねんとう}{所感|しょかん} (New Year's reflections)
- Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{念頭|ねんとう}→念頭：12572_nentou⟧ (in mind; consideration), which is a completely different word

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年頭|ねんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: New Year's greeting
- {年頭|ねんとう}{所感|しょかん}: New Year's reflections/address
- {年頭|ねんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たり→当たり：01919_atari⟧: at the start of the year (formal opening)
- {年頭|ねんとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: New Year's goals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{年始|ねんし}→年始：17689_nenshi⟧: beginning of the year, New Year — more commonly used for New Year's visits and greetings
- ⟦{新年|しんねん}→新年：09787_shinnen⟧: New Year — the most general term
- {年初|ねんしょ}: beginning of the year — very similar, slightly more neutral/calendrical
